notes: «فسألت ماذا قال قالوا نهى أن ينتبذ» — Ibn Umar asks and «قالوا» (people, unnamed) tell him the Prophet's ruling: an unnamed link at that point (rule 8)
«قرأت على مالك» is Yahya's reading to Malik, so Malik is the link; «قال ابن عمر فأقبلت نحوه» is Ibn Umar's own account in the scene
the Prophet is the end; the Companion Ibn Umar is written before the unnamed source
